metadata.question: Did the air temperature reach over 58 degrees Celsius at the Furnace Creek Visitor's Center on June 30, 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Furnace Creek Visitor Center in Death Valley, California (approximately 36.46°N, 116.87°W) - Date: June 30, 2013 (single day) - Collection: ERA5-Land or MODIS Land Surface Temperature. ERA5-Land provides 2m air temperature which is what we need (not land surface temperature). ERA5-Land has hourly data in Kelvin. 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5-Land reanalysis data (complete coverage) - Need to find maximum temperature for the day 3. Logic: - Convert Kelvin to Celsius - 58°C = 331.15K - Get maximum temperature across all hours on June 30, 2013 - If max temp > 58°C → A (Yes) - If max temp ≤ 58°C → B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid result) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const furnaceCreek = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.8667, 36.4564]); const startDate = '2013-06-30'; const endDate = '2013-07-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land hourly data for air temperature let collection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(furnaceCreek) .select('temperature_2m'); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No ERA5-Land data found for this date."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Get maximum temperature across all hours const maxTemp = collection.max(); // 4. Extract temperature value at point const result = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: furnaceCreek, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const tempKelvin = result.temperature_2m; // 5. Validation & Conversion if (tempKelvin === null || tempKelvin === undefined) { console.log("Temperature value is null."); console.log("C3"); return; } const tempCelsius = tempKelvin - 273.15; console.log(`Maximum air temperature on 2013-06-30: ${tempCelsius.toFixed(2)}°C (${tempKelvin.toFixed(2)}K)`); console.log(`Threshold: 58.00°C`); // Check for unrealistic values if (tempCelsius < -100 || tempCelsius > 100) { console.log("Temperature value outside realistic range."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Final Answer if (tempCelsius > 58.0) { console.log("Temperature exceeded 58°C."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Temperature did not exceed 58°C."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
